The whole or cut dried leaf of Althaea officinalis. Protect from light. Profile Althaea is demulcent and emollient and has been used for irrita- tion and inflammation of the mucous membranes of the mouth and pharynx, and relief of associated dry cough. It has also been used in traditional remedies for a variety of disorders including gastrointestinal disturbances. 2254 Supplementary Drugs and Other Substances Preparations Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Fr.: Primadrill; Ger.: Phytohustil; Pol.: Althagem; Althamel; Rubital.
